articles.summary: We are making the mounting of control and instrumentation devices even easier. The mild steel and stainless steel Consolets will soon be upgraded with welded nuts as a standard feature, speeding up installation and enhancing stability. In addition to this upgrade, we’re also introducing optional panels to support your applications.The Consolets will retain their existing catalog numbers. Panel catalog numbers align with the corresponding Consolet catalog number to ensure the correct size:
articles.title: Consolet Panel Nuts and Panels Update Coming Soon

articles.summary: The Lay-In Flat-Cover Type 1 wireway in both galvanized and painted finishes has been redesigned to feature a convenient “snap” fit connection, making installation quicker and easier. At this time, the feature enhancement is limited to the 4.00 x 4.00 inch and 6.00 x 6.00 inch solution sizes, present on all wireway Straight Section lengths as well as the joining U-Connectors. The “snap” fit design brings the following:
articles.title: Commercial Wireway Type 1 with New Snap Connect Design
